def native_entry(source, i, j, router):
    (k, z) = (source['momentum'], source['radical'])
    rows = []
    original = source['livePencil'][i, j]
    router.observe('original', original)
    (num, den) = router.operation('fraction', 1, router.operation('cancel', 0, original))
    router.observe('num', num)
    router.observe('den', den)
    a = router.operation('Poly', 2, num, k, z)
    router.observe('a', a)
    b = router.operation('Poly', 3, den, k, z)
    router.observe('b', b)
    reconstructed = sum((v * k ** p * z ** t for ((p, t), v) in router.operation('terms', 4, a))) / sum((v * k ** p * z ** t for ((p, t), v) in router.operation('terms', 5, b)))
    router.observe('reconstructed', reconstructed)
    residual = router.operation('cancel', 6, reconstructed - original)
    router.observe('residual', residual)
    f.require(residual == 0, 'full rational end entry reconstruction')
    rows.append({'row': i, 'column': j, 'original': original, 'numeratorTerms': router.operation('terms', 7, a), 'denominatorTerms': router.operation('terms', 8, b), 'reconstructionResidual': residual})
    router.observe('entry', rows[-1])
    return rows[0]
